hero.industry: Water & Sewage Infrastructure & Urban Real Estate Development

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: EPC: STP (up to 56MLD), RDSS (33kV substations, feeders), Jal Jeevan (rural water networks); Real Estate: 75L sqft delivered in NCR; 2 active projects: VVIP Namah (6.21L sqft, Rs. 500cr revenue), VVIP Addresses (12L sqft, Rs. 900cr revenue share); 2 new land acquisitions: Yamuna Expressway (25 acres, Rs. 800cr+ revenue), Greater Noida West (12L sqft, already launched)

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: Rs. 869cr total: STP Rs. 335cr (39%); RDSS Rs. 326cr (37%); Jal Jeevan Mission Rs. 208cr (24%)

guidance.title: Guidance
guidance.body: revenue growth: 40% CAGR target for EPC; margin: 15-17% sustainable for EPC, 20-25% for real estate; order inflow: Rs. 448cr pipeline; capex/commissioning: Rs. 900cr in-house capex for real estate projects over next 3-4 years

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: Expansion into Delhi STP projects (Rs. 400cr pipeline), NBCC/CPWD government building tenders, potential entry into Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: EPC: 15-17% sustainable (up from 14% in FY25); Real Estate: 20-25% EBITDA margin; consolidated blended margin 17-18%; cost efficiencies from scale, procurement, and in-house construction

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: Prioritizing internal cash flow for real estate construction; no immediate fundraising planned; potential debt increase up to 1:1 debt-equity ratio if needed; focus on bank guarantees and mobilization advances

management_tone.title: Management quality / tone
management_tone.body: Highly confident, aggressive, and disciplined; committed to quarterly disclosures; focused on execution speed, margin discipline, and land bank monetization; no inventory retention policy in real estate

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: Real estate revenue recognition delays due to RERA/completion timelines; execution risk on Rs. 869cr EPC order book; dependency on government payment cycles (though now resolved); land acquisition delays

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: EPC construction for real estate projects (Rs. 900cr) is fully in-house — meaning EPC revenue from real estate is not outsourced and fully captured in group P&L, creating a hidden revenue stream
